tools.name: list_bpj_ai_tools
tools.description: Find BPJ tools by name, slug, English or Chinese keywords, or category. Use includeSchema for inputs and examples. Continue with nextOffset. The empty call includes the original catalogue and the first 100 suite tools.

tools.name: review_task_state
tools.description: Rule-based preflight for an explicit task state. Does not read chat histories or predict a calibrated success probability.

tools.name: run_bpj_ai_tool
tools.description: Run a BPJ suite tool found through list_bpj_ai_tools. Pass its exact freeMcp name and arguments matching its inputSchema.

tools.name: bpj_text_inspect
tools.description: Count Unicode code points, UTF-8 bytes, lines and whitespace-delimited fields to check size limits.

tools.name: bpj_normalize_whitespace
tools.description: Collapse repeated whitespace with a choice to preserve line breaks.

tools.name: bpj_deduplicate_lines
tools.description: Remove blank and repeated lines in first-seen order.

tools.name: bpj_compare_line_sets
tools.description: Find additions, removals and retained items between two line lists.

tools.name: bpj_replace_literal
tools.description: Replace all non-overlapping occurrences of a literal string and report the count.

tools.name: bpj_make_readable_slug
tools.description: Convert a title to a hyphen-separated slug with support for Unicode letters.

tools.name: bpj_count_word_frequency
tools.description: Rank runs of Unicode letters, marks and numbers by frequency.

tools.name: bpj_search_text_context
tools.description: Find literal matches and return UTF-16 offsets with neighboring text.

tools.name: bpj_extract_web_links
tools.description: Extract and deduplicate absolute HTTP and HTTPS URLs in first-seen order.

tools.name: bpj_find_invisible_characters
tools.description: Locate invisible formatting controls, nonbreaking spaces and other uncommon separators.

tools.name: bpj_chunk_text
tools.description: Split by a maximum code-point count with a preference for nearby whitespace. Chunks rejoin to the original text.

tools.name: bpj_csv_to_json
tools.description: Use the first row as keys and preserve quoted commas and line breaks. Cells remain strings.

tools.name: bpj_json_to_csv
tools.description: Export scalar fields from an array of objects. Formula-like string cells receive an apostrophe prefix.

tools.name: bpj_csv_to_markdown_table
tools.description: Use CSV headers to produce a document-ready Markdown table.

tools.name: bpj_profile_csv
tools.description: Count blanks, populated cells, distinct values and repeats per CSV column.

tools.name: bpj_pivot_csv_counts
tools.description: Count observed combinations of two columns, such as category and status.

tools.name: bpj_filter_csv
tools.description: Return the columns and records that match a supplied exact column value.

tools.name: bpj_numeric_summary
tools.description: Calculate mean, median, quartiles, extrema and population standard deviation.

tools.name: bpj_format_json
tools.description: Parse JSON and format it with the selected indentation. Zero produces compact output.

tools.name: bpj_flatten_json
tools.description: List leaf values with their JSON Pointer paths, including empty containers.

tools.name: bpj_read_json_pointer
tools.description: Read an object field or array entry using JSON Pointer. An empty pointer selects the whole value.

tools.name: bpj_compare_json
tools.description: Report added, removed and changed paths. Object member order is ignored and arrays are compared by position.

tools.name: bpj_profile_json_records
tools.description: Summarize field presence, missing values, nulls and observed types in a sample of JSON records.

tools.name: bpj_check_json_lines
tools.description: Validate JSON Lines and report invalid line numbers and valid record types. Blank lines are ignored.

tools.name: bpj_apply_json_merge_patch
tools.description: Apply RFC 7396 JSON Merge Patch. Null object members remove fields and arrays are replaced as a whole.

tools.name: bpj_gross_margin
tools.description: Calculate gross profit, gross margin, and markup from revenue and direct costs.

tools.name: bpj_break_even_units
tools.description: Find the minimum whole units needed to cover fixed costs at a given price and variable unit cost.

tools.name: bpj_cash_runway
tools.description: Estimate months of runway from a cash balance and constant monthly income and spending.

tools.name: bpj_customer_ltv_cac
tools.description: Estimate contribution LTV and acquisition payback assuming constant monthly churn, revenue, and gross margin.

tools.name: bpj_funnel_backsolve
tools.description: Backsolve the minimum estimated volume at each stage for a target conversion count.

tools.name: bpj_period_growth
tools.description: Compare starting and ending values and calculate compound growth per period.

tools.name: bpj_compound_growth_plan
tools.description: Project the balance with periodic growth followed by an end-of-period contribution.

tools.name: bpj_proportional_budget
tools.description: Allocate a budget by weights, rounding with largest remainders so the shares sum to the total cents.

tools.name: bpj_sprint_capacity
tools.description: Estimate sprint hours available for delivery after team absence, recurring duties, and a contingency reserve.

tools.name: bpj_business_day_offset
tools.description: Add or subtract weekdays, excluding listed holidays and the starting day.

tools.name: bpj_time_window_overlap
tools.description: Find the overlap of two same-day time windows in one time zone.

tools.name: bpj_meeting_labor_cost
tools.description: Calculate participant-hours and labor cost for recurring meetings, including preparation.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_bpj_ai_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List first-party BPJ AI workflow tools, capabilities and availability. Separate from third-party directory." → after: "Find BPJ tools by name, slug, English or Chinese keywords, or category. Use includeSchema for inputs and examples. Continue with nextOffset. The empty call includes the original catalogue and the first 100 suite tools."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
